name: Renzokuken (5 hits)
doc: Renzokuken, 5 hits (Squall's limit break): the master and the controller - Squall's animation set and sequence bound (its hits are the sequence's), the gunblade's trail, the sparks, the five hits' slashes with their flashes and debris, the closing slash, the screen flash and his tint, the sound. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag141_renzokuken_5hits.cpp) run on the program's memory.

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Controller
parts.doc: Squall's Renzokuken: his animation set and sequence, the gunblade's trail, the sparks, the five hits' slashes with their flashes and debris, the closing slash, the screen flash and tint, the sound

params.label: Flash
params.doc: The sprite sequence flash (a flipbook of 16 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Debris
params.doc: The sprite sequence debris (a flipbook of 11 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Spark
params.doc: The sprite sequence spark (a flipbook of 10 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Sparkle model
params.doc: The prim model sparkle (a mesh of 18 vertices, 8 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Slash model
params.doc: The prim model slash (a mesh of 96 vertices, 72 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Streak model
params.doc: The prim model streak (a mesh of 21 vertices, 20 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Final model
params.doc: The prim model final (a mesh of 97 vertices, 96 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Texture file
params.doc: The texture file its loader reads from the magic folder (a name of at most 31 letters)

params.label: Camera track
params.doc: The camera track its setup plays (any length: its offsets are its own)

params.label: Animation set
params.doc: The animation set it binds to its caster: body animations, sequence scripts, weapon animations ({count, offsets, end}, the game's count)

params.label: Hit leads
params.doc: Each hit's lead (how far ahead of its slash) (48 bytes: an edited one keeps its length)
